items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I took lessons from Cozy, when I was learning how to read

ctx.x: Yes, he is. But Cozy, you know, I took lessons from Cozy, when I was learning how to read, I went to Cozy, when he had a was out of school, because he was on 54th Street and 8th Avenue, and I took lessons from him for about 4 months.

Now Cozy was responsible for me getting interested in learning about rudiments, because I didn't know anything about rudiments -- I didn't know a five stroke from a seven stroke rudiment, and a rose was a rose to me, you know?

items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: It was my guest on the albums were Gene Krupa, Ray McKinley and Panama Francis.

ctx.x: And you also did a record with Henry Jerome and yourself and three other drummers.

Yeah, they were my guests on this album, It was Henry Jerome's idea and we did all commercial tunes, and each of us had a track. It was my guest on the albums were Gene Krupa, Ray McKinley and Panama Francis.
And that was done in '62 for Coral.
